connections.label: National Reconnaissance Office
connections.note: Since 1995 the National Reconnaissance Office has occupied a 68-acre compound at the Westfields International Center in Chantilly, Virginia, part of the Northern Virginia intelligence corridor this node stands for.

sources.name: National Reconnaissance Office, Contact Us (14675 Lee Road, Chantilly, VA 20151-1715)

desc: Virginia carries an unusual double weight on this board. As a state it holds the densest concentration of intelligence and defence institutions in the country - Langley, the Pentagon across the river, Quantico, and the contractor corridor through McLean and Chantilly - so a very large share of the people catalogued here worked within its borders. As a specific locus it anchors Charlottesville, the base of Steven M. Greer, whose Disclosure Project assembled several hundred military and government witnesses and staged the National Press Club event of 9 May 2001, an operation that put uniformed retirees on camera at scale for the first time.
